# LogicCore runtime (purchased component)

Placeholder. "LogicCore" is the fictional supplier of the runtime that executes control applications
on the Venue Controller.

Planned content, as a device manufacturer would receive it:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| binary of the runtime | no source code; packaged by us from freely licensed open-source components |
| supplier SBOM | CycloneDX, with the supplier's own naming |
| supplier advisory | CSAF with VEX statements ("not affected", "fixed in") |
| release notes | version and change information as text |

No binaries of real runtime suppliers are stored here.
